_note: Public model providers the privacy gateway may use, in order. Every request is redacted first. The first entry uses the caller's own key (the Dahl key the caller sends). A fallback needs enabled=true, a model, and a key FILE NAME under D:\jarvis-secrets (the key itself never goes in this file). Free tiers change: check the provider's current terms (jarvis/docs/reports/evidence/06-models-hardware-providers.md section 9). Gemini's free tier is excluded for personal data (its terms allow training on it).

providers.name: dahl
providers._note: A caller that sends its own key gets that key through (the plugins do). A caller that sends none, or the placeholder jarvis-local (the face does), gets the key in D:\jarvis-secrets\providers\dahl.key; if that file is missing the request goes out as it came and Dahl answers 401. The gateway hides the reasoning of a reply to the face (reasoning_content and <think> text). OPTIONAL, off until checked live: rename _face_extra_body_example to face_extra_body (or to extra_body for every caller) to ask Dahl to skip the thinking for the face's chat. Whether Dahl honours chat_template_kwargs for this model is NOT verified; a provider that does not know it may answer 400, then remove it.

providers.name: groq
providers._note: Owner's first fallback (2026-10-16). Inactive until D:\jarvis-secrets\providers\groq.key exists (skipped as 'no key file'). Base-plan limits on Groq's docs (2026-10-16): 30 requests/min, 1,000/day, 8K tokens/min for this model; over the limit Groq answers 429 (the gateway then moves on), it does not bill.

providers.name: cerebras
providers._note: Owner's second fallback (2026-10-25), for when Dahl is busy. Inactive until D:\jarvis-secrets\providers\cerebras.key exists (skipped as 'no key file'). Free Trial limits on Cerebras' docs (read 2026-10-25): gpt-oss-120b and qwen-3.8-27b, 5 requests/min, 30K uncached tokens/min, 90K total tokens/min, 1M tokens/hour and /day: room for the face's big tool requests that Groq's 8K/min cannot take. Base URL and the qwen id are from the docs' introduction; the gpt-oss-120b id is from the rate-limit table. Public lane only: free-tier training terms are not confirmed (sources conflict), and every request is redacted first anyway.
